findings.title: Card budget rule can cut or drop the PR title, which revision 6 defines as never-altered publish bytes; mockups 01 and 03 show it cut
findings.where: CR-003 §12.1 budget rule and bounds table (subject/title line ≤ 300, untrusted part cut with '…'), vs §5.1 notes, U8, U14, ADR-0019 Option A, DESIGN §14.4a; §5.9 Confirm panel; mockups 01 and 03
findings.problem: title_max is 256 code points with no schema upper bound, and each character can cost 8 escaped characters (⟦U+XXXX⟧, &), so a valid title can need ~2,048 escaped characters. The design doesn't say whether the PR title line is the bounded 'subject/title' required block (then it is cut with '…' above 300) or an optional block (then the budget rule may drop it). Either way the Approve-bearing card can show less than open_pr publishes and title_sha256 binds. Mockups 01 and 03 show the title ellipsized on the card and on the Confirm panel.
findings.fix: §12.1: add 'the PR title line (open_pr; publish bytes, never cut or dropped)' to the required blocks with bound ≤ 2,100 (title_max × 8 + label + '[edited by you]'); keep the 300 bound and '…' cut for the issue line only; reword to 'except publish bytes (the PR title), which are never cut'; the required set is ≤ 3,100 < 3,900. Strict config schema: policy.text.title_max ≤ 256. §5.9: the Confirm panel either shows the full title or has no title line (pick one and match mockup 03). AC 1/53: Hypothesis case with a 256-char title of '&' and U+200B rendering in full inside <code> within 3,900. Mockups 01 and 03: show the title in full (wrapped).

findings.title: Drafts in flat mode and ✅ Reviews are not wrapped by answer_view, so raw Hermes text streams next to approval cards
findings.problem: Only final messages go through answer_view (header plus one quote). Every turn starts a draft, so a flat-mode or Reviews turn can briefly show an unlabeled lookalike card (no buttons, 30 s).
findings.fix: §6.1: in ✅ Reviews no draft is sent (sendChatAction typing only); in flat mode every draft is built by answer_view.render(…, thread_kind='flat'), header first and the draft text in one quote. Extend test_answer_view.py / AC 48 with a flat-mode lookalike draft.

findings.title: Normal-path Telegraph publish leaves the confirm panel at '⏳ Publishing…'
findings.where: CR-003 §6.8 steps 1 and 4, §14.5 Telegraph rows, BA-20
findings.problem: Success is a new reply to the answer, and the failure texts name no target, so the panel only resolves on the /kill paths. Step 4's 'the panel never stays at ⏳ Publishing…' is true only for /kill.
findings.fix: Step 4 and BA-20: the shielded section always edits the panel to its outcome ('📖 Published · see reply below' or the after-stop text) under article:<page_path>:announce; the normal path also sends the step-4 reply (article:<page_path>:reply). Every §14.5 Telegraph failure text is a panel edit.

findings.title: Graceful shutdown doesn't await the shielded Telegraph request, so a created page can go unrecorded
findings.where: CR-003 §12.5 item 4 (Handlers.drain), the telegraph kind (asyncio.shield(inner)), BA-20
findings.problem: inner is not a spawned task, so drain() doesn't await it. A down during createPage can leave a public, undeletable page with no telegraph_pages row, no /articles entry and no Unpublish handle.
findings.fix: BA-20: create inner with Handlers.spawn(inner_coro, 'telegraph_commit'); TaskKind gains 'telegraph_commit', which is not in KILL_CANCELS, so drain() awaits it like submit. Add a 'drain during a held createPage → page recorded' case to test_telegraph.py.

findings.title: 'A render-time scan() hit is a bug' is not true for Hermes-staged skill parts
findings.where: CR-003 U14, §12.1 scan() and 'One scanner' bullet, §9
findings.problem: Skill files are verbatim and scanned at render, but no earlier gate checks them for gatekeeper secret values. Hermes holds HERMES_API_KEY and writes the skills, so a hit dead-ends at the '(bug)' withheld stub instead of a reason.
findings.fix: §9 / §12.4.2: SkillApprovals.create (or the FEAT-009 staging hook it wraps) runs ctx.secret_scanner.scan over every skill file first; on a hit it refuses with 'gatekeeper_secret (<file>)' as a plain notice in 💬 Assistant and creates no approval. Add the case to test_secret_scan.py.

findings.title: 📋 Copy title assumes the title fits copy_text, but the length units may differ
findings.problem: If Telegram counts copy_text in UTF-16 units, a 256-code-point title with astral emoji is over the limit and the picker send fails with 400, and the title may not be cut.
findings.fix: §5.8: show 📋 Copy title only when the title's UTF-16 length is ≤ 256; otherwise omit the button and say 'Title too long to copy; it is shown in full in 🧭 Explore → PR text'. Add a §17 [VERIFY] item for the copy_text length unit.
